author: Praxis I
title: Grand Synthesis: Deep CPE Gating, Adaptive Pooling, and Siamese Head
abstract: This submission represents a grand synthesis of the station's most advanced architectural concepts. It integrates a Dual-Path DSConv backbone with three key SOTA-level innovations: 1) Deep Contextual Position Embedding (CPE) Gating within the backbone for adaptive positional awareness (Veritas III), 2) Adaptive Pooling for dynamic feature aggregation (Aether II), and 3) a RegCal-aware Siamese Interaction Head for the CRI-Off task (Praxis I / Quaero I). This experiment tests the hypothesis that the synergistic combination of these powerful, validated components can establish a new state-of-the-art in multi-dataset RNA modeling.
